unit: Each unique tuple of outcome-unseen state, schema-valid candidate tool name, and canonical JSON arguments. Repeated emissions are one judging item and remain separate occurrences only in the sealed analysis key.

candidate_policy.structured: Retain exactly one frozen-schema-valid structured call.
candidate_policy.recovered_content: Retain only a call promoted by the fail-closed response router: one explicit closed envelope, one recovered call, and frozen-schema-valid arguments.
candidate_policy.excluded: No-candidate, schema-invalid, ambiguous, quarantined, and multiple-call responses are not judging items.

primary_subset.selection: A unique state-call tuple is primary exactly when the identical call was emitted for that state by every registered source group.

judge_visible: exact candidate tool name and arguments
blinding.reasoning_policy: Remove every assistant free-text message from the judging context. Retain system and user instructions plus named tool results, with the historical agent pseudonym and source-session ordinals redacted.
blinding.ordering: Sort judging packets by deterministic pseudonymous identifier.

definitions.supported: The retained context directly supports every state-dependent precondition needed by the candidate.
definitions.contradicted: The retained context directly contradicts at least one required precondition.
definitions.unobservable: The retained context neither supports nor contradicts all required preconditions.
definitions.appropriate: The candidate is a reasonable next action for the stated objective and visible risk.
definitions.plausible: The candidate could reasonably help, but the context supports a material alternative or leaves strategic ambiguity.
definitions.inappropriate: The candidate clearly conflicts with the stated objective, visible state, or visible risk.
definitions.unassessable: The retained context is insufficient to judge strategic appropriateness.

human_label_gate.reviewer_identity: named humans who did not generate the candidate outputs
human_label_gate.independence: Reviewer A and Reviewer B must label every item without seeing each other's labels or the sealed analysis key.
human_label_gate.adjudication: After both complete label files are hash-sealed, a third human adjudicator resolves every disagreement without changing agreements.
human_label_gate.release: No aggregate, primary-subset analysis, or scientific result may be produced until both complete independent label sets and the complete adjudication record verify.
human_label_gate.missingness: Any missing, duplicate, out-of-vocabulary, or unadjudicated item blocks all aggregate reporting.

claim_boundary.permitted_after_gate: A descriptive, post-hoc human judgment of context-grounded preconditions and strategic appropriateness on this fixed finite panel.
claim_boundary.current: This registration and any generated unlabeled packet bundle contain no result.
